{{Vanilla|Nether Brick}}
{{Infobox auto}}
A '''hellbrick''' is a single brick made from [[hellstone]]. It is the vanilla {{MCW|Nether Brick|nether brick}} item under a new name. Four make a block of [[hellbricks]].

== Obtaining ==
=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
Hellbricks are made by cooking hellstone in a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]] for {{Value|Hellbrick|cook_time|station=Blast Furnace}}. The vanilla furnace recipe is removed, so an [[oven]] cannot make them; cooking hellstone in an oven instead gives a whole block of hellbricks at once.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/nether_brick.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/nether_bricks_from_smelting_netherrack.json}}</ref>

=== Other sources ===
{{Sources}}
* Mining hellstone with a tool that has the [[Adamant equipment|adamant]] tool intrinsic drops hellbricks directly, affected by [[Fortune]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/netherrack.json}}</ref>
* [[Piglin]]s can barter 2–8 hellbricks.
